name: Gáe Bulga

attributes.attribute: The famous weapon of the Irish hero Cúchulainn.
Scáthach, the warrior woman of the Isle of Skye, gave it to him.
A spear or javelin that could slice through flesh.
He used it to kill his son Connla and his foster brother Ferdiad.
Some scholars link the second part of the name to the Fir Bolg race.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Gáe Bulga was the famed weapon of the Irish hero Cúchulainn. Scáthach, a fierce warrior of the Isle of Skye, gave it to him. This spear or javelin could slice through flesh and gave its bearer a keen edge in battle. Cúchulainn used it to kill his son Connla and his foster brother Ferdiad. Some scholars link the name's second part to the Fir Bolg race.

okr.objective: Present the Gáe Bulga as Cúchulainn's spear given by Scáthach, used against his son and foster brother.
